data.one_liner: Flutter widgets for beautiful Arabic text justification using Kashida instead of spaces.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized text and rich text widgets designed specifically for Arabic typography. It intelligently distributes Kashida characters across words to achieve justification while preserving diacritics and automatically excluding sacred words like Allah.
use_when: You need justified Arabic text layout in your Flutter app.
You want to avoid awkward wide spaces between words in Arabic paragraphs.
You need to handle Arabic diacritics (Tashkeel) and mixed text properly.
avoid_when: You are using ArabicJustifiedRichText and require WidgetSpan support inside your text.
You need high performance with extremely long texts exceeding 10,000 characters.
strengths: Smart Kashida distribution instead of extra spaces
Automatic exclusion of sacred words like Allah and custom word lists
Supports diacritics, mixed text, and line breaks
weaknesses: Last word wrapping issues can occur with certain Quranic fonts
Performance may degrade with extremely large blocks of text
